verses.text_uthmani: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
verses.transliteration: Haa Meeem

translations.text: Ha, Meem.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wal Kitaabil Mubeen

translations.text: By the clear Book,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Innaaa anzalnaahu fee lailatim mubaarakah; innaa kunnaa munzireen

translations.text: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].

verses.text_uthmani: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.transliteration: Feehaa yufraqu kullu amrin hakeem

translations.text: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Amram min 'indinaaa; innaa kunnaa mursileen

translations.text: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]

verses.text_uthmani: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Rahmatam mir rabbik; innahoo Huwas Samee'ul 'Aleem

translations.text: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

verses.text_uthmani: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbis samaawaati wal ardi wa maa bainahumaa; in kuntum mooqineen

translations.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.

verses.text_uthmani: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa yuhyee wa yumeetu Rabbukum wa Rabbu aabaaa'ikumul awwaleen

translations.text: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Bal hum fee shakkiny yal'aboon

translations.text: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fartaqib Yawma taatis samaaa'u bidukhaanim mubeen

translations.text: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.

verses.text_uthmani: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Yaghshan naasa haazaa 'azaabun aleem

translations.text: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.

verses.text_uthmani: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.transliteration: Rabbanak shif 'annal 'azaaba innaa mu'minoon

translations.text: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."

verses.text_uthmani: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: Annaa lahumuz zikraa wa qad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum mubeen

translations.text: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.transliteration: Summaa tawallaw 'anhu wa qaaloo mu'allamum majnoon

translations.text: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.transliteration: Innaa kaashiful 'azaabi qaleelaa; innakum 'aaa'indoon

translations.text: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma nabtishul batsha tal kubraa innaa muntaqimoon

translations.text: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad fatannaa qablahum qawma Fir'awna wa jaaa'ahum Rasoolun kareem

translations.text: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,

verses.text_uthmani: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.transliteration: An addooo ilaiya 'ibaadal laahi innee lakum Rasoolun ameen

translations.text: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"

verses.text_uthmani: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa al laa ta'loo 'alal laahi innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen

translations.text: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa innee 'uztu bi Rabbee wa rabbikum an tarjumoon

translations.text: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.transliteration: Wa il lam tu'minoo lee fa'taziloon

translations.text: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."

verses.text_uthmani: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fada'aa rabbahooo anna haaa'ulaaa'i qawmum mujrimoon

translations.text: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa asri bi'ibaadee lailan innakum muttaba'oon

translations.text: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.transliteration: Watrukil bahra rahwan innahum jundum mughraqoon

translations.text: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kam tarakoo min jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: How much they left behind of gardens and springs

verses.text_uthmani: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Wa zuroo'inw wa maqaa min kareem

translations.text: And crops and noble sites

verses.text_uthmani: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa na'matin kaanoo feehaa faakiheen

translations.text: And comfort wherein they were amused.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Kazaalika wa awrasnaahaa qawman aakhareen

translations.text: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.

verses.text_uthmani: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: Famaa bakat 'alaihimus samaaa'u wal ardu wa maa kaanoo munzareen

translations.text: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqad najjainaa Baneee Israaa'eela minal'azaabil muheen

translations.text: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -

verses.text_uthmani: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.transliteration: Min Fir'awn; innahoo kaana 'aaliyam minal musrifeen

translations.text: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa laqadikh tarnaahum 'alaa 'ilmin 'alal 'aalameen

translations.text: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.transliteration: Wa aatainaahum minal aayaati maa feehi balaaa'um mubeen

translations.text: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna haaa'ulaaa'i la yaqooloon

translations.text: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.transliteration: In hiya illaa mawtatunal oolaa wa maa nahnu bimun shareen

translations.text: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.

verses.text_uthmani: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.transliteration: Faatoo bi aabaaa'inaaa inkuntum saadiqeen

translations.text: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."

verses.text_uthmani: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.transliteration: Ahum khayrun am qawmu Tubba'inw wallazeena min qablihim; ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen

translations.text: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
verses.transliteration: Wa maa khalaqnas samaawaati wal arda wa maa baina humaa laa'ibeen

translations.text: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.

verses.text_uthmani: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.transliteration: Maa khalaqnaahumaaa illaa bilhaqqi wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon

translations.text: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.transliteration: Inna yawmal fasli meeqaatuhum ajma'een

translations.text: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -

verses.text_uthmani: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shai'anw wa laa hum yunsaroon

translations.text: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Illaa mar rahimal laah' innahoo huwal 'azeezur raheem

translations.text: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.transliteration: Inna shajarataz zaqqoom

translations.text: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum

verses.text_uthmani: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Ta'aamul aseem

translations.text: Is food for the sinful.

verses.text_uthmani: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.transliteration: Kalmuhli yaghlee filbutoon

translations.text: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies

verses.text_uthmani: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Kaghalyil hameem

translations.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

verses.text_uthmani: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Khuzoohu fa'tiloohu ilaa sawaaa'il Jaheem

translations.text: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,

verses.text_uthmani: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Summa subboo fawqa raasihee min 'azaabil hameem

translations.text: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."

verses.text_uthmani: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Zuq innaka antal 'azeezul kareem

translations.text: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Inna haazaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon

translations.text: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Innal muttaqeena fee maqaamin ameen

translations.text: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;

verses.text_uthmani: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Fee jannaatinw wa 'uyoon

translations.text: Within gardens and springs,

verses.text_uthmani: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
verses.transliteration: Yalbasoona min sundusinw wa istbraqim mutaqaabileen

translations.text: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.transliteration: Kazaalika wa zawwajnaahum bihoorin 'een

translations.text: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

verses.text_uthmani: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.transliteration: Yad'oona feehaa bikulli faakihatin aamineen

translations.text: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.

verses.text_uthmani: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.transliteration: Laa yazooqoona feehal mawtaa illal mawtatal oolaa wa qaqaahum 'azaabal jaheem

translations.text: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire

verses.text_uthmani: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.transliteration: Fadlam mir rabbik; zaalika huwal fawzul 'azeem

translations.text: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fa innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika la'allahum yatazakkaroon

translations.text: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.transliteration: Fartaqib innahum murta qiboon

translations.text: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
